info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Image Graph API
info.description: The ImageGraph.get API call lets you generate beautiful static PNG Graphs for any existing Matomo report.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to query.
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
(Required) API module name of the source report.
(Required) API method name of the source report.
Optional graph type.
Output mode: inline image, saved file, or raw PHP graph object.
Optional comma-separated metric names to plot.
Optional comma-separated row labels to include for evolution graphs.
Whether the graph legend should be displayed.
Optional graph width in pixels.
Optional graph height in pixels.
Base font size used in the graph.
Optional legend font size.
Whether anti-aliasing should be enabled.
Optional goal ID for report methods that support goals.
Optional comma-separated list of hex colors to use in the graph.
Hex color used for text.
Hex color used for the background.
Hex color used for grid lines.
Optional subtable ID for source reports that use subtables.
Whether the metric name should be appended to legend labels.
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
Optional dimension ID for reports that support dimensions.

request.description: Generates a static graph image for a Matomo report.

response.name:
Generated graph output, depending on the selected output type.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
